BASELINE-SET.books_view: beta-matched book is the row's net/gross; all books' decomposition inside gates_with_margins_to_fail

limb_shadow_folds.rule: inverted net>0 on a fold where anchor net<=0

limb_band.rule: placebo net >= 0.5 x anchor net @ k1.0

limb_fold_residue.rule: placebo net>0 on >=4/6 folds AND anchor net < 2 x placebo net
